user.title: Connect to QWeather
user.description:
Enter the API Host from your QWeather console, without a scheme or path. Location is longitude,latitude. Interval is in seconds; all products use up to six requests per refresh.
For JWT, enter the credential, developer and project IDs and the Ed25519 private key path inside HA; leave API Key blank. JWT fields are ignored for API Key authentication.
Night hours use HA local time and may cross midnight. Equal start/end hours or disabling the schedule uses the fixed interval all day. 600 seconds = 10 minutes; 1800 seconds = 30 minutes.

init.title: QWeather options
init.description:
Interval is in seconds (minimum 300). The 24-hour precipitation total requires at least 24 forecast hours. Disabling a supplemental product makes its screen data unavailable.
Night hours use HA local time and may cross midnight. Equal start/end hours or disabling the schedule uses the fixed interval all day. 600 seconds = 10 minutes; 1800 seconds = 30 minutes.
